_comment: Copy to studio.config.json and fill in what you have. Every key is optional — without one the studio falls back to something local: template copy instead of a model, Wikimedia Commons instead of Pexels, macOS `say` instead of Gemini or ElevenLabs. Environment variables (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PEXELS_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, SERPAPI_API_KEY) work too and take second place to this file.
_copyProvider: Which model writes the copy: "deepseek", "anthropic", or omit to use whichever key is set (DeepSeek first if both).
_geminiVisionModel: Blitz reads a short's on-screen text with this. Leave it out and it tries gemini-3.5-flash, then gemini-flash-latest, then gemini-2.5-flash.
